summary_rationale: UnitedHealth Group operates an unmatched healthcare flywheel combining 48.3 million domestic insurance lives at UnitedHealthcare with Optum's $270.6 billion care-delivery, analytics, and PBM franchise, generating $447.6 billion in FY2025 revenue and $19.7 billion in operating cash flow. However, a 2024-2025 operational shock—driven by the $2.3B-$2.45B Change Healthcare cyberattack, Medicare Advantage V28 risk-model mispricing, an 89.1% FY2025 MCR, and an Optum Health operating loss of $(278)M—compressed ROIC to 6.1%-9.4% (below its ~8.6% WACC). Under returning CEO Stephen Hemsley and CFO Wayne DeVeydt, 9M 2026 operating earnings rebounded to $23.5B with Q3 2026 MCR improving 150 bps to 88.4%, but 2027 Star Ratings slipping to 68%-71% in 4+ star plans and ongoing DOJ/FTC scrutiny keep the enterprise on conditional watch until ROIC sustainably exceeds WACC.
